content_sections.heading: UASD Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About UASD
content_sections.text: The University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad runs the All India Coordinated Research Project (AICRP) on Soybean at its Main Agricultural Research Station in Dharwad. These posts fall under the National Mission on High Yielding Seeds - Soybean scheme (head of account no. 560146/310). Dr. K Gopalakrishna Naidu is the Principal Investigator, and the Director of Research approved the engagement by a letter dated 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a direct interview. If two or more candidates get equal marks, SC/ST candidates receive preference for the temporary appointment.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The place of work is the AICRP on Soybean at the Main Agricultural Research Station, Dharwad. The engagement runs until 31 March 2027, the end of the project, or the receipt of government clarification on temporary appointments in projects, whichever comes first. Because the appointment is temporary, the appointee may be removed from work at any time without being given a reason. The appointment gives no right to a permanent appointment in the University, and service here cannot be claimed towards a permanent post. Before joining, the selected candidate must submit an undertaking on Rs. 100/- stamp paper in the prescribed Format-TR-2.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UASD Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application format given in the annexure on page 3 of the notice, and sign it. Paste a photograph in the space provided. Prepare two copies of the application format. Have the copies of your documents attested and bound into two sets. Report at 2:00 PM on the interview date to the office of the Associate Director of Research (Headquarters), University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad. Do not send the application in advance. Candidates attend at their own expense. Application format (annexure), two copies All original educational documents Two bound copies of the attested documents (mandatory) Two photographs

faq.question: Q1. Which degree is required for the UASD Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The post requires an M.Sc. (Agri) in Genetics and plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q2. Can I post the application to the university before the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the application must not be sent in advance under any circumstances. Bring two copies of the annexure form to the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Which work gets preference?
faq.answer: Preference goes to candidates with Soybean Breeding or Molecular work.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the Senior Research Fellow engagement last?
faq.answer: It can last until 31 March 2027 at the most. It ends earlier if the project ends or government clarification on temporary project appointments arrives first.

faq.question: Q5. What happens if two candidates get equal marks?
faq.answer: SC/ST candidates receive preference for the temporary appointment.

faq.question: Q6. What must a selected candidate submit before joining?
faq.answer: The candidate must give an undertaking on Rs. 100/- stamp paper in Format-TR-2, confirming the terms on claims to a permanent post.

faq.question: Q7. Will the university pay my travel expenses for the interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must attend at their own expense.
